incidentReports.title: OpenRouter report: platform outage across Stashlify
incidentReports.summary: Stashlify had a real platform outage from 19 Apr 2026 through 24 Apr 2026. Core services were fully down at first, then recovered into degraded state while the incident was still active.
incidentReports.impact: Dashboard, inventory, orders, payments, and authentication were unavailable or unreliable across the incident window.
incidentReports.resolution: Service recovered after backend stabilization and the outage window closed on 24 Apr 2026.
